config.goal: Port encoder_backward_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/encoder_backward.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T C V` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 1e-05 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources. The migrate tool (SYCLomatic) is not available in this run: write the SYCL port yourself from the CUDA harness (read it in parts with read_file offset/limit).
